source.what: the compressibility curve under a dictionary budget: x = dictionary share of the raw bytes, y = delta share, ratio = x + y (MDL, all costs included)
source.curve: C1, coder 30-copy-shrink, values of layer 3 head 0 (256 B entries), FP8 E4M3, 4096-token blocks, dev split (2 sequences), no read budget; tracks v-l3h0-fp8-b4k and -x02 / -x10 / -x25 (x_max budgets)

receipts: research/ASK_HUMAN.md r1.Q1 (r1 session-2 measurement of the curve, best coder per budget, 30-copy-shrink)
notes: KNOWLEDGE 'Dictionary budgets' section cites 15 trials: of the curve's ['r1-t0030', 'r1-t0031', 'r1-t0036', 'r1-t0037'] it cites [] (budget/frontier quotes coder 30's scores without trial ids); of the best-per-budget extras it cites ['r1-t0042', 'r1-t0046', 'r1-t0056', 'r1-t0058']
